d: We are EnerMech, a specialist service company that delivers safe, integrated solutions for complex energy projects. For over 50 years, we’ve been energizing our clients across the world with unrivaled expertise, equipment, and technology that supports the entire asset life cycle – offshore and on land. We enable progress through our three global business lines: Energy Solutions, Infrastructure & Industrial Solutions, and Lifting Solutions. Within these areas, we offer a wide range of services, including cranes, lifting, fluid power, training, equipment rental, pipeline, subsea, process, and valves – all designed to help you optimize performance, enhance reliability, and improve efficiency. With a focus on operational excellence, we deliver value through our customized integrated solutions. This approach reduces risk and enhances efficiencies making us a leading and trusted partner every step of the way.

EnerMech is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive organization. We believe that diversity enriches our team, and we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, cultures, and identities.
r: Accountable for the financial control of assigned projects, working hand-in-hand with the Project Manager to secure and enhance the “As Mobilised” forecast Gross Profit of the project and outperforming the “As Mobilised” forecast cash curve if applicable.
Provide clear visibility and control of project working capital including, Accrued Income, Account Receivables, WIP, GRNI and Accounts Payable.

Working with the Project Manager, ensure that there is a clear understanding of key contractual terms and that all assumptions and constraints in the “As Bid” forecast Gross Profit are well understood.
Ensure a clear understanding of the split of the budget elements between internal and external labour required to deliver the project scope by supporting the Project Manager in resource planning.
Ensure that the project team has obtained clear line of sight of own equipment v hired-in / purchased equipment required to deliver the customer requirements identified.
Ensure that key logistic requirements and consumables have been appropriately identified, so that the costs can be reliably forecast in the “As Mobilised” forecast Gross Profit.
Verify project revenue and cost baseline and ensure that any differences between the “As Bid” and “As-Mobilised” forecast Gross Profit are submitted to the Business Line VP for approval and sign-off.

Ensure the creation of the customer sales order in Navision with the approved WBS structure and ensure that a detailed revenue & cost budget along with all relevant milestones if applicable are correctly input.
Ensure the creation of Job Code in Navision with the approved WBS tasks and ensure the management of active(live) job codes in line with the phased execution of the project.

Ensure that the “As Mobilised” phased revenue and cost forecast is taken on into Mercury and BFT at the required level of granularity, reconciled to the approved budget baseline, before the project is released into execution.
Ensure that all timesheets and purchases are timely and correctly recorded on the project throughout the project execution phase.

Work with the Project Manager and Invoicing Coordinators to ensure the timely approval and invoicing of all work completed in line with contractual requirements / milestones and manage the prioritisation of invoicing where a factor is used.
Ensure that the Project Manager’s signs-off monthly project performance including key KPI's, working capital, GP performance, project CAC and cashflow forecast if applicable.

Accountable for the integrity of the project forecast held in Mercur and BFT throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring that at all times it reflects the agreed scope, the current execution schedule and the latest assessment of risks and opportunities.

Accountable for a single, reconciled version of the forecast, ensuring that the values held in Mercure and BFT agree, that Navision actuals reconcile to the forecast structure, and that any differences are identified, explained and resolved.
Ensure the effective financial close-out and archiving of project financial documentation.
Monitor commitments and accruals and track contingencies, provisions and management reserves

Support the Project Manager in cost forecasting (EAC/ETC) and monitor project financial performance v budget & forecast, identify variances and establish root cause. Track customer PO cover and notify the Project Manager of potential breaches
Implement cost control measures agreed by Project Manager as necessary
Participate in deep-dive project reviews and analysis, supporting Finance Leadership and Project Managers with a clear view of forecast GP evolution verses previous forecast.
Work with business line teams to understand performance variances and coordinate with SSC to ensure accurate variance explanations in management reports.
Ensure correct rates are charged to the client in accordance with the SOR outlined in the contract or PO
Ensure that all previous month’s cost accruals are reversed and review and equipment off-hire has been processed as per schedule provided by the PM
Analyse timesheet reporting for completeness / coded and that contractor invoices align with timesheets
Review receipted PO’s (GRNI) reporting from the SSC and approve accruals
Review unposted supplier invoices reporting from the SSC and approve accruals, avoid double counting
Manage revenue recognition (accrued income), ensuring accurate and timely recording of income in accordance with FRS15, contract terms / milestones and group accounting standards and policies.
Approve accrued income / AR & WIP provisions and client bonus if applicable and request to SSC to process entries Maintain cost accruals for cost which has not been invoiced or receipted
Finalize GP analysis and prepare project KPI's incl. BS / Working Capital & follow-up reason for trends. Issue pack to PM by work day 3/4(EUR/AMEC) / work day 7/8(APAC/AMER)

Run GP reviews with Project and Operations Managers, capturing key discussion points and agreed amendments or corrections, either at a job or service line level, to ensure revenue and costs are aligned. Ensure that final adjustments are recorded by the SSC and submit final report to PM for sign-off.
Support the Business Line with the consolidation of projects for profitability reporting, conduct variance analysis, commentary and support the Business Line leads on query resolution.
For month end reporting, provide supporting commentary and analysis for review with Geography FDs. Identify and highlight financial trends, providing actionable insights to support decision-making.
Review regular Business Line/Service Line/Jobs profitability reports produced by SSC R2R team and support with query resolution related to the production of regular reports.
Assess financial impact of change orders and ensure the update of forecasts (CAC/GP) to reflect impacts.
Implement and monitor project-level financial controls. Support the Project Manager in identifying project risks with mitigations and opportunities with plans to crystalise them.

Support management decision making regarding risk and opportunity management by supporting in the probabilistic quantification of risks and opportunity impacts and ensuring the integration of impacts into the forecasts CAC/GP.

Support the SSC Collections team by providing input on collections. Ensure that the Project Manager prioritises invoices that may have significantly impact on accrued income and/or accounts receivable provisions
Ensure clarity regarding client disputes and support Geography FC and FD in challenging collections issues such as settlement negotiations.
Provide the FC and FD with supporting documentation required to manage bad debts accurately.
Process journal via the SSC R2R team, raising requests with supporting documentation, and reviewing/approving journals.
Maintain data integrity across systems, support gate reviews and audits, and ensure compliance with financial governance requirements.
Execute financial close-out including closing all job task numbers, delivering final invoices, cost reconciliation, reporting and archiving of all financial documentation.
Maintain comprehensive project financial documentation for audit, legal, and contractual purposes
Coordinate with internal and external auditors for project-related reviews and compliance checks
Raise risks and issues in service delivery to the SSC Leads.
Support service performance improvements, root cause analysis and removal of blockages in service delivery.
Review and manage any escalations or exceptions as raised by the SSC team, further escalating to Geography FC and FD as needed.
Support the financial controller in balance sheet reconciliation review, open items resolution, liaising with SSC to enable final sign-off and support action plan for unreconciled items.

Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates a portfolio of 29 exceptional properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, Asia, and Africa. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and since then the brand has become known for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels, and exclusive branded residences. Jumeirah is synonymous with Arabian luxury hospitality and the ability to craft distinctive, purposeful experiences for the world’s most discerning travellers.

Located on the pristine beaches of Bahrain’s West Coast, the resort features stunning ocean views, verdant greenery, and meandering waterways with modern, spacious rooms and suites as well as an exclusive Gulf Summer House, located directly on the beach. Guests can enjoy a variety of water sports activities, the resort’s five pools, and book treatments at Jumeirah’s signature Talise Spa.
